blocking_findings.issue: β#4 requires report-mode behavior to stay byte-identical on the two wrappers that already consulted the shape resolver. Both report-mode advisory strings now insert `(${door.mode})`, changing stderr from `shape-resolver advisory:` to `shape-resolver advisory (report):`. That violates the explicit no-regression contract and can break consumers/tests comparing dispatch output bytes.
blocking_findings.fix: For dispatch-agent and dispatch-claude, preserve the exact legacy advisory string when `door.action !== "refuse"` and `door.mode === "report"`; only use the new mode-labelled wording for enforce/refusal paths or for newly-doored wrappers.

non_blocking_notes: Sanctioned-lane suppression is keyed on `fallbackSanctioned`, not the bare `--review-fallback` flag.
Epsilon consult is on the CLAUDE_RAW path only and returns a failed dispatch instead of process.exit on refusal.
dispatch-skill passes `reportOnlyPin:true`, so enforce cannot false-refuse skills.
Legacy `WARPOS_DISPATCH_CONTRACT_ENFORCE=block` is preserved as a shape-door enforce alias.
parsed.summary: FAIL: the core wiring is mostly correct, but report-mode stderr is not byte-identical on the existing wrappers.
